US officials, under Biden and Trump, who have aided and abetted these crimes by providing taxpayer dollars, bombs and political support to Israel have no place in future administrations.

NPR, man. So many times did I used to wake up and turn on NPR while I ran, dressed, ate, etc. The real history lesson we should take is that NPR didn’t *used* to be an obvious bullshit factory.
No it the fuck was not.

1. This is huge.  Kat Abughazaleh, Andre Martin, Michael Rabbitt, Cat Sharp, Brian Straw, and Jocelyn Walsh fought a fascist prosecution and won

2. This should not be over. We should know everything about what happened and people should lose more than their jobs
